thread:
ara: Quick follow-up thread for runtime Q&A items we promised to publish after today's all-hands. Keeping it short: batching knobs, KV cache policy, kernel-v4 canary gates, and customer comms.
dom: who owns the final SLO numbers that go into the public playbook? Also want an explicit statement on what "fallback" means operationally.
kevin: ops/infra owns the numeric SLOs but product signs off on public wording. Proposal: publish p50/p95/p99 with a note that network egress adds X ms depending on region.

kevin: suggested numbers (internal): hosted p50=22ms, p95=130ms, p99=420ms. Dedicated p50=14ms, p95=85ms, p99=260ms. These are starting points; we'll lock them after the next perf sweep.
ivy: fallback semantics proposal: 1) avoid silent-quality change for SLA customers (no auto-quantize). 2) best-effort tier may accept auto-quantize or smaller-model fallbacks with explicit consent. 3) every fallback emits a trace and a user-visible header (X-Model-Fallback).
dom: +1 to user-visible header. Also request that fallback incidents surface to the customer dashboard for a limited time (48h) with links to traces.
kevin: we can implement trace + header quickly. Dashboard surfacing needs product UX but put it on the backlog.
ara: batching: clarify adaptive vs fixed. We recommended adaptive microbatching with a per-worker cap and an opt-out header. Example config for the RFC:
```
batching:
  strategy: adaptive
  worker_max_batch: 56
  latency_target_ms: 60
  priority_header: X-Request-Priority
```
dom: status on cross-worker pooling? That is trickier. Let's defer cross-worker pooling to post-kernel-v4 rollout; priority: complexity vs value.
kevin: KV cache: ops will run a 14-day experiment increasing hot-prefix retention to 18m on a small cluster and measure p95 and memory cost. If cost delta < 6% and p95 improves > 5% for primary routes, recommend enabling adaptive hot-extension.
ivy: product wants a one-sentence blurb for marketing: "Best-effort routes may use quantized or smaller model variants under high load; SLA routes will not be silently downgraded." Can eng draft wording?
dom: I'll draft two sentences and share in RFC.
kevin: kernel-v4 rollout plan (compact): finish microbench suite Mon, stage-1 canary (10% non-SLA) in 9 days if green, stage-2 (50%) two weeks later, full rollout conditional on quality + perf gates. Quality gate: sampled eval delta < 1.0 on internal metric. Perf gate: p95 regression < 5% vs baseline.
ops-bot: Meeting notes saved: https://redwood.internal/notes/allhands-2732109876. :white_check_mark:
ara: action items I'll track: 1) dom draft public blurb (dom) 2) kevin run KV experiment (kevin) 3) kevin publish perf sweep numbers for SLO lock (kevin) 4) eng-platform add fallback header + telemetry (platform). Please update this thread when done.
